column2: [intro]
In my naive texts, I escape without restraint,
Anyone can interpret them, it's a free lane.
But I mean no harm, that’s my intention,
No limits, just a beautiful creation.
In these light-hearted songs, I let my creativity flow,
Without aiming for deep discourse or a show.
I just want to entertain, make you smile,
With no intention to harm, just to make life worthwhile.
The naivety in my words is my signature,
Each person can find their own obscure fixture.
But I’m not here to offend, I swear,
My only goal is to spread pure air.
